meaning:
ὑδροποτίω, -ῶ
(ὕδωρ, πίνω), [in LXX: Dan LXX 1:12 שָׁתָה מַיִם) * ;]
to drink water, opposite to οἴνῳ χρῆσθαι: 1Ti.5:23 (Hdt., i, 71; Plat., Rep., 561 with, al.).†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: Be no longer a drinker of water only, but use a little wine for your stomach’s sake and your frequent infirmities.
